## Orientation

Researchers stop collecting for many reasons. A deadline arrives. Access closes. New searches repeat old results. The corpus seems sufficient. These reasons should not be disguised as one claim that the evidence is complete.

## Learn

Coverage testing compares the developing corpus with the dimensions and source families on the map. Look for empty cells, thin cells, dependent cells, contradictory cells, and cells filled by one institutional perspective. A large number of records can conceal weak coverage when they repeat one source stream.

The language of saturation has several meanings and does not fit every qualitative tradition.^[See @saunders2018saturation and @braun2021quality.] Information power offers another way to reason about adequacy: a focused aim, specific material, strong dialogue with the evidence, theoretical support, and an intensive analytic strategy can reduce the amount required.^[See @malterud2016information.] These ideas concern sampling and analysis. An evidence map adapts them cautiously to documentary collection.

Track information yield. A search cycle has high yield when it adds a new source family, changes a definition, reveals a rival explanation, fills an important gap, or alters the interpretation of existing evidence. Yield declines when new records repeat known information from the same underlying sources.

Digitized documentary corpora deserve a coverage test of their own. A newspaper database is a sample of a historical press that had its own structure, and the sampling is rarely documented. The environmental scan formalizes the audit: reconstruct the full press landscape from contemporary directories, then measure what the digitized corpus includes and omits by politics, price, and geography.^[See @beelen2023environmental.] Later work generalized the method into three measurable questions: what was never digitized, how far the sample diverges from the known population, and whether over-represented titles skew the corpus language itself.^[See @beelen2025whosenews.] Interviews with digitization providers explain where the selection came from. Microfilm availability and commercial calculation drove it more often than scholarly priorities did.^[See @hauswedell2020selection.]

Recognition errors compound selection. Optical character recognition failures approach one word in five in some national newspaper archives, and multi-word phrase searches fail more often than they succeed; any count of mentions inherits those errors silently.^[See @burchardt2023ocr.] Datasets derived from such collections by machine learning inherit them a second time.^[See @lee2021compounded.] Infrastructure can be built to expose these limits rather than conceal them. The Impresso project, which enriches multilingual historical newspapers with entity recognition and text-reuse detection, surfaces recognition confidence and corpus composition in its interface so that a researcher can distinguish a historical silence from an artifact of digitization.^[See @duering2024transparent; on the measured performance of entity recognition on historical text, @ehrmann2024survey.]

## Worked Example

A terrorism corpus may contain thousands of event records while remaining thin on coding changes, local reporting gaps, or the institutional reasons that one event entered the database and another did not. Coverage testing shifts attention from event totals to the process that produced them.

## Try It

Mark each evidence-map cell as empty, thin, adequate for the present claim, contradictory, or inaccessible. Write one sentence defending every “adequate” judgment. Then rank the unresolved cells by their likely effect on the argument.

## Guided AI Workflow

Provide a redacted summary of the map. Ask the model to identify repeated dependence, absent actor perspectives, unsupported comparisons, and claims resting on one source family. Verify each observation against the actual register. The model sees the summary supplied to it, not the evidence itself.

## Integrity Checkpoint

Some gaps should remain. Ethical restrictions, participant safety, legal obligations, and community agreements can make collection improper. Record these as protected gaps rather than methodological failures.

## Save the Artifact

Save the gap analysis with priority, consequence, proposed action, access constraint, and decision date. A later researcher should be able to distinguish an overlooked gap from a known limit.

## Advanced Practice

Contradiction is not a defect to eliminate. It may reveal distinct institutional views, temporal change, strategic deception, or differences in measurement. The map should preserve disagreement until the analysis explains why it exists.
